==Notes==
*As the [[recharge time]] of spells can never be reduced by more than 50%, there is no way to permanently maintain this skill without outside assistance due to its short duration. While [[Deadly Paradox]], [[Arcane Echo]] and [[Arcane Mimicry]] can be used to prolong the duration, they are insufficient to maintain Shadow Form.
